title: Methyl-CpG-binding protein 2 reads histone methylation via an aromatic cage to regulate gene expression and chromatin association.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究MeCP2-MBD通过芳香笼读取组蛋白甲基化（H3K27me3）并调控染色质结合与基因表达，涉及蛋白-DNA（MeCP2与DNA）及蛋白-组蛋白互作，但核心是组蛋白修饰识别而非TF-DNA特异性结合，且方法以实验为主、仅含对接与ChIP-seq分析，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: Methyl-CpG binding protein 2 (MeCP2) is a DNA methylation reader, which is highly expressed in the central nervous system. Loss-of-function mutation of MeCP2, which impairs DNA binding, causes Rett syndrome, while gain of MeCP2 function causes MeCP2 duplication syndrome. MeCP2 functions as both a transcription activator and a repressor, but its full range of activity remains largely unknown. A recent study suggests that beyond DNA binding, MBD domain of MeCP2 also interacts with methylated lysine residues on histone H3 tail. In this study, we aimed to characterize the methyllysine-binding pocket of MeCP2-MBD. Structural analysis reveals the presence of an aromatic cage formed by five residues, namely, W104, F132, Y141, F142, and F155, where the trimethyllysine of H3K27me3 binds, as confirmed in docking studies. Alanine substitution of these residues abolished the binding of MeCP2-MBD with its reported ligand H3K27me3 in ITC and pull-down experiments. Genomic analysis of publicly available ChIP-seq data reveals that MeCP2 localizes with canonical histone methylation marks like H3K4me3, H3K9me3, H3K27me3, and H4K20me3 and regulates critical biological and cancer-related pathways. Promoters of MeCP2-regulated genes show a signature of H3K4me3 and H3K27me3. At the genomic level, mutation of aromatic cage residue W104A significantly reduced chromatin occupancy of MeCP2 as demonstrated by ChIP-qPCR experiments. Furthermore, our qRT-PCR experiment shows that this aromatic cage-dependent binding is necessary for regulating the expression of MeCP2 target genes. Overall, our study establishes MeCP2 as a histone methylation reader and highlights the functional significance of its histone binding capacity in chromatin association and gene regulation.
abstract_zh: 甲基-CpG结合蛋白2（MeCP2）是一种DNA甲基化读取器，在中枢神经系统中高表达。MeCP2的功能缺失突变会损害DNA结合，导致Rett综合征，而MeCP2功能增强则引起MeCP2重复综合征。MeCP2既作为转录激活因子又作为抑制因子发挥作用，但其全部活性范围在很大程度上仍属未知。近期一项研究表明，除DNA结合外，MeCP2的MBD结构域还与组蛋白H3尾部的甲基化赖氨酸残基相互作用。在本研究中，我们旨在表征MeCP2-MBD的甲基赖氨酸结合口袋。结构分析揭示了由五个残基（即W104、F132、Y141、F142和F155）形成的芳香笼的存在，H3K27me3的三甲基赖氨酸结合于此，这一点在对接研究中得到证实。在ITC和pull-down实验中，这些残基的丙氨酸替换消除了MeCP2-MBD与其已报道配体H3K27me3的结合。对公开可用的ChIP-seq数据进行基因组分析揭示，MeCP2定位于典型的组蛋白甲基化标记（如H3K4me3、H3K9me3、H3K27me3和H4K20me3）处，并调控关键的生物学和癌症相关通路。MeCP2调控基因的启动子显示出H3K4me3和H3K27me3的特征。在基因组水平上，芳香笼残基W104A的突变显著降低了MeCP2的染色质占据，这一点通过ChIP-qPCR实验得到证实。此外，我们的qRT-PCR实验表明，这种依赖芳香笼的结合对于调控MeCP2靶基因的表达是必需的。总体而言，我们的研究确立了MeCP2作为组蛋白甲基化读取器的地位，并强调了其组蛋白结合能力在染色质关联和基因调控中的功能重要性。
